name: cairnfield-node
description: Cairnfield team node: a Cloudflare Worker that holds a team's repos on Artifacts and serves the node contract.

scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env team-a && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env team-b
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --env="" --var NODE_URL:${NODE_URL:?set NODE_URL to the base URL of this node} --var INDEX_URL:${INDEX_URL:-}
scripts.deploy:team-a: wrangler deploy --env team-a --var NODE_URL:${TEAM_A_NODE_URL:?set TEAM_A_NODE_URL to the base URL of the team-a node} --var INDEX_URL:${INDEX_URL:-}
scripts.deploy:team-b: wrangler deploy --env team-b --var NODE_URL:${TEAM_B_NODE_URL:?set TEAM_B_NODE_URL to the base URL of the team-b node} --var INDEX_URL:${INDEX_URL:-}
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run deploy:team-a && npm run deploy:team-b

ADMIN_KEY.description: The node's admin key. The `cairnfield` command sends it to import a component, create a fork and get repo tokens, so only your team should hold it. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. A node with no key refuses every admin call.

NODE_URL.description: The node's own base URL, which is its identity. It is the origin this Worker answers at, in lower case, with `https://` and no slash at its end. On `workers.dev` that is `https://<worker name>.<your subdomain>.workers.dev`.

INDEX_URL.description: The address of the index this node tells about each push: an HTTPS URL with no slash at its end. It is optional. A node with none sends no notice, and its team works alone.
